releaseNotes:
## AgentOS 2.0.0-beta.11

- Added signed in-product update management with persistent stable/beta channel selection, download verification, installation progress, service restart, reconnect confirmation, and a safe read-only boundary for source checkouts
- Moved all public Core installers, signed channel manifests, and AgentOS Runtime artifacts to `wutianle/agentos-releases`; the private source repository now contains source history and source tags only
- Unified the public Runtime product name as AgentOS Runtime while preserving target-specific local and Cube asset filenames for architecture clarity
- Added offline AgentOS Runtime import for Cube environments, including base template architecture detection, archive structure and digest validation, renamed-file support, duplicate reuse, progress reporting, and visible ready-to-save state
- Added portable Cube target archives by rewriting Runtime store links so the verified package can be extracted outside the original build filesystem
- Consolidated version, progress, inline status, notice, and footer treatments through shared settings components and fixed repeated control spacing

### Verification

- Passed the complete 264-test TypeScript, Server, UI, and TypeScript SDK suite after a production build
- Passed all 10 Java 8 SDK tests and built the `2.0.0-beta.11` SDK JAR
- Passed the Sandbox VMM Go test suite
- Assembled and checksum-verified AgentOS Runtime `1.0.0-beta.3` for local macOS arm64, Cube Linux amd64, and Cube Linux arm64 targets
- Booted the macOS Runtime through Apple Virtualization.framework and verified the packaged Harness runtime before publishing
- Installed the signed Core archive with the matching local Runtime in an isolated prefix, then passed version, doctor, Core health, sandbox health, signed-update API, and packaged-browser checks
